title: UpdateWaitsOn

reason.description: Why the environment is busy: run-starting and run-running (a run is starting or running), parked-prompt (a run parked on a prompt in the last ten minutes), recent-activity (a run started or ended in the last ten minutes).

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

until.description: When the reason stops counting if nothing else happens; null while a run is starting or running.

description: What a waiting update waits on: the reason the environment is busy, and until when.
